thread:
Priya Patel: Heads up — nightly ingest for asia region last night shows a gap: ~12,100 embed rows missing for customer Polaris between 03:00-03:15 UTC. Metering ledger shows no corresponding billable token activity for that window. Do we treat this as a replay-ready backfill or issue a proration credit?

BillingBot: [alert] ingest_pipeline shard-7 failed 2026-03-21T03:07:12Z -> retry scheduled. Job id: rp-asia-7. Logs: `Err: socket timeout after 10s`

Lina Moreno: I pulled S3 manifests and the connector retry tombstones. Quick query:
```
SELECT ingest_shard, count(*) as rows, min(ingest_time), max(ingest_time)
FROM embeds_raw
WHERE ingest_time >= '2026-03-21T02:50:00Z' AND ingest_time < '2026-03-21T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY ingest_shard;
-- shard-7 => 0 rows; other shards normal
```

Ethan Cole: If shard-7 replayed later, did the replay pipeline mark those as "replayed" vs new? We need to know whether metering already counted them when they succeeded later.

Jae Kim: I checked the replay log: rp-asia-7 completed at 2026-03-21T04:10:21Z and wrote 12,143 rows to embeds_canonical. However the metering-forwarder crashed during the write window, so the billing topic didn't receive the ack messages.

Priya Patel: Summary: data landed but billing did not capture the events. Customer-facing invoice shows lower embed usage than reality. We need a reconciliation plan: (A) backfill billing messages and run downstream recount, (B) manually prorate the billed usage for the affected invoice period, or (C) issue a one-off credit. Thoughts?

Maya Tan: We prefer backfill when possible — less customer-facing noise. How reliable is the replay->backfill path? how long to rerun?

Jae Kim: Backfill path exists but requires rehydrating the kafka topic for that day and replaying ack events. Estimated time: ~2 hours of eng work + safe window to validate. Risk: duplicate-billing protection must be toggled so it accepts backfills for that customer.

Ethan Cole: Operational constraints: if we backfill, we need finance signoff to accept the adjusted invoice delta before the next billing cycle cutoff (invoice generation 2026-03-25). If not, credit flow is faster but opaque to auditors.

Priya Patel: Can eng produce a small proof-of-fix artifact (hash of replayed batch + count) so we can attach to the invoice reconciliation email? That would help audit trail.

Jae Kim: Yes — we'll produce: batch_id=rp-asia-7, rows=12143, sha256=3f7a9b... and a replay manifest.

Lina Moreno: Also found one more oddity: tokenization service emitted an extra newline earlier that caused 2 rows to be merged in later stages; effective embed count = 12143 but dedup logic currently flags 2 of them as combined. We should include a note about a 2-row reconstruction caveat in the reconciliation.

Maya Tan: Approve backfill plan provided eng can produce the audit artifact and schedule the replay today. Finance will tentatively hold invoice adjustments pending receipt. If backfill fails or takes >48h, escalate to issuing a pro-rated credit.

Priya Patel: Action items: @Jae Kim to run backfill today and upload manifest + sha; @Lina Moreno to attach query output; @Ethan Cole to prepare provisional invoice delta (estimate: credit ~ $1,230 based on embed price tier) and hold until we confirm. I'll update Polaris with a brief note that we are reconciling and will notify them once adjusted. :+1:

Ethan Cole: Draft for Polaris notification (for Priya to send): "We've identified an ingestion/billing mismatch affecting your March 21 usage window (03:00-03:15 UTC). We're reconciling and will either adjust your invoice or apply a credit within 48 hours. No action required on your side." Thoughts?

Priya Patel: Good. Please put the draft in #customer-communication for legal signoff.

BillingBot: [info] ticket created FIN-7421: "Polaris - asia shard-7 ingest gap / backfill" assigned to @Jae Kim.

Jae Kim: Starting backfill now (rp-asia-7). Will post final artifact when completed.

Priya Patel: Thanks — will wait for artifact before making invoice adjustments.

Lina Moreno: Uploaded query.csv to the FIN folder with the raw counts and manifests link: s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-03-21/polaris-shard7-manifest.csv

Jae Kim: Backfill complete at 2026-03-21T05:20:33Z. Artifact: batch_id=rp-asia-7, rows_written=12143, sha256=3f7a9b8e5c2d4f... Link: s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-asia-7/manifest.json

Ethan Cole: Recalculated provisional delta -> $1,187.50 (rounded). Marking FIN-7421 status: awaiting finance reconciliation.

Maya Tan: Approved adjustment. Finance: please apply delta to Polaris account and include replay manifest in billing notes.

Priya Patel: Done — invoice adjustment queued and note attached. Closing thread once Polaris confirms. :white_check_mark:
